messages:
ana: hi folks, first week checklist question: i can view Grafana dashboards and Datadog monitors but i can't edit dashboards or create Datadog API keys. also Sentry for our service returns "Project not found". who owns Datadog key grants vs Grafana editor vs Sentry invites?

devex-bot: Hey @ana! Grafana Editor requests go through the access portal: https://internal.redwood.com/access-requests -> choose 'Grafana Editor' and add your team tag. Datadog API key creation is restricted; request 'Datadog Integration' access in the same portal. Include justification like "onboarding: create monitor/integration for infra-service". Typical turnaround 1-2 business days.

elena: @ana i handle Sentry project invites. "Project not found" usually means you're not in the correct org/SSO. What's the email you signed in with? if it's SSO use your @redwood.dev address. i'll invite you to infra-service-prod once you DM me the email.

tom: quick note on Datadog keys: we discourage long-lived owner keys. For integrations we prefer creating a scoped API key and using the service account (datadog-ops) instead. If you need to run local scripts, ask for "datadog-monitoring-scoped" and we'll create a key with limited permissions.

ana: thanks all (typo: i'm ana). i used ana.hr@redwood.dev for SSO. i'll DM @elena. also what's the path in Grafana to request folder-level edit? i see dashboards -> Manage but not folder-specific settings.

elena: got your DM and sent the invite to ana.hr@redwood.dev. Accept via SSO and you should see the project.

observability-bot: Note: infra dashboards are owned by folder "platform-dashboards". Folder-level edit is controlled via the access portal role "Grafana Editor" plus explicit ACL on the folder. If you need folder ACLs changed, include folder name in the request.

ana: submitted access request for Grafana Editor + Datadog Integration with justification "onboarding: infra-service dashboards and monitors". included folder name "platform-dashboards".

eng-oncall: @ana if you're touching production monitors, add "prod-impact" to the request. we can temporarily mute noisy monitors while you make changes. For Datadog monitors that fire during onboarding, post the monitor URL here and we'll mute for a window.

tom: FYI, when you create a new Datadog monitor, tag it with team:eng-infra and add an annotation in the alert-change log: https://git.internal.redwood.com/infra/alerts. saves a lot of oncall noise.

ana: sweet. one more Q: for local testing with Datadog API, is it okay to use the scoped dev key or should i always use the service account?

tom: use the scoped dev key for local dev. request TTL 7 days in the portal. for automation or CI, use the datadog-ops service account and rotate keys via the secrets repo.

ana: thanks everyone. accepted Sentry invite and will wait for Grafana + Datadog approvals. i'll paste monitor/dashboard links here when i start changing thresholds. :thumbsup:
